name: Deployment Approval Required
description: A Release Package requires a current, unexpired approval with no outstanding Critical or High Obligation before production deployment.

conditions.statement: Release Management Service has issued an approved release recommendation for this exact package version.
exceptionRules: Emergency rollback deployment may bypass approval, subject to retrospective review.

conditions.statement: The approval was issued within its declared validity window (has not gone stale relative to the deployment attempt).
No Critical or High severity Obligation remains open against this Release Package at deployment time.
